verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's node system pairs companion devices (macOS, iOS, watchOS, Android, headless) to the Gateway. Each node exposes a command surface with CLI helpers for camera, screen, device, notifications and system. The built-in `computer` tool can also see and control a paired node's desktop, so the assistant clearly reaches beyond one machine. Missing for 10: no evidence of media-playback control on paired devices, and no independent or hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
